data.completion_memo: Implemented the core-only CanonicalCommitter LocalSqlite route, enforcing one history binding per Chat and delegating atomic ordered event/checkpoint/dedup/outbox commits to the local-store commit adapter. Pending delivery is observable only after commit. cargo test -p aworkit-trusted-core passes.
data.description: Implement the Canonical Event Committer's LocalSqlite path over the atomic commit adapter. Enforce exactly one history binding per Chat, stable event ordering, command/invocation deduplication, checkpoint identity, and durable worker/UI delivery outboxes before acknowledgement.
data.title: M04.4 — Implement canonical local event routing and delivery outboxes
